Then we are looking for you!Samsung SDS is looking for enthusiastic Logistics Employees to strengthen our team at our warehouse in Tilburg.What do we expect from you?- You have a hands-on mentality and a proactive attitude.- You are motivated, reliable and eager to learn.- You are physically fit and able to perform physically demanding work, including lifting, carrying and standing for extended periods. (you have to be able to lift 25 kg)- You enjoy working in a team but can also work independently.- You are flexible and able to work in a two-shift system (6.00 - 14:30/ 14:30 - 23:00)- You have a good understanding of safety and quality standards.- Experience in logistics or warehouse operations is an advantage, but not essential.- You have a good command of English. - You have your own accommodation. We do not provide this for you

Luba  Reachtruck Driver  - Oudkarspel - 38 tot 40 uur - Uitzicht op vast - Mbo Start as a reachtruck driver snacks in Oudkarspel. Work with tasty products, receive shift and freezer allowances. Read on to find out more!  Over het werk Do you want to work at the logistical heart of a snack factory? As a reach truck driver snacks, you transport, store, and collect ingredients, semi-finished products, and finished products in the warehouse. You work with products that are imported and exported worldwide. You regularly drive into the freezer area and receive an attractive freezer allowance for this. Of course, you'll receive proper work clothing and sturdy shoes. You'll work in two shifts: from 6:00 AM to 3:00 PM and from 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM, with a shift allowance after 6:00 PM. This position offers plenty of opportunities for personal development and growth. You start your day with a short briefing with colleagues. Then you get started on the reach truck: receiving raw materials, placing products in the right location, and preparing orders for transport. Working in the freezer area is part of the job. Thanks to your efforts, the warehouse remains organized and safe, and production runs smoothly. You work efficiently, keep a good overview, and enjoy working in an international and dynamic environment. Would you like to contribute to snacks that are loved worldwide?
